title: fix(actions): make 'Open' (opensInNewTab) feel instant, not stuck
body:
Fixes the #1 control-plane UX complaint: clicking **Open** on an env pre-opened a blank tab, then awaited a slow SSO-handoff mint with no feedback → looked frozen → users re-clicked (more blank tabs/requests); when the popup was blocked it silently hijacked the current tab after the wait.

ObjectView + RecordDetailView:
- **Paint a '正在为你打开环境…' spinner into the pre-opened tab immediately** — never looks blank/frozen during the mint.
- **Re-entrancy guard** — ignore repeat clicks while the same action+record is in flight (no duplicate tabs/requests).
- **Blocked-popup fallback** — show a 'popup blocked → 打开环境' toast with a one-click (fresh-gesture) open instead of silently navigating the current tab.
